title: Open the Lock
problemStatement: You have a lock with four circular wheels, each displaying a digit from 0 to 9. Initially, the lock displays "0000". In one move, you may rotate any one wheel one position forward or backward. Some combinations are deadends. If the lock reaches a deadend, it can no longer be used. Given the list of deadends and a target combination, determine the minimum number of moves required to reach the target. Return -1 if it is impossible.
input: Integer d Array of deadend strings Target string
constraints: 1 <= d <= 500 Every combination has exactly four digits.
